observation: Version 3 passed its 512 MiB/no-rising-pageout host admission, passed all 104 warning-strict tests, and completed 14 of 19 generated qualification arms. The GRU arm then failed because the shared predict function passed capture_trace=False to GRUForecast.forward, whose control interface intentionally has no S14 retrieval-trace keyword. Five qualification arms and all market intake and historical cells remained not started.
defect: A diagnostic-only S14 keyword leaked through the shared non-trace prediction call into the GRU control. The existing tests covered S14 tracing but did not execute the GRU control through predict.
repair: When capture_trace is false, call every model only with the shared positional forecast interface. Pass capture_trace=True only for the full S14 trace request. Add a numerical regression test that sends a generated validation batch through GRUForecast via predict and checks finite forecast laws.
scientific_change: None. Thresholds, folds, arms, seeds, cohort rules, budgets, labels, scores, and protected boundaries are unchanged.
decision: Freeze the repair as separately versioned FREM-S14-0.1.6. Rebuild immutable artifacts and require complete warning-strict tests and CUDA qualification before market intake. Preserve Version 3 and every failed or not-started cell.
